# OmniAI Studio

> OmniAI Studio is an AI automation and intelligent systems studio based at omniaistudio.in.

## Identity

OmniAI Studio is the studio operating this website. Its focus is practical AI automation and intelligent systems for business use cases.

## Core specialties

- AI automation and business process automation
- AI agents and bounded task-execution systems
- Document intelligence and structured data extraction
- Workflow orchestration and API integrations
- Custom internal tools and AI-powered business systems

## Work

- [Work](https://omniaistudio.in/work): portfolio of projects and systems
- [AI Invoice Extractor](https://omniaistudio.in/work/ai-invoice-extractor): portfolio project exploring AI-assisted invoice extraction, structured output, validation, and downstream automation

## Services

- [Services](https://omniaistudio.in/services): AI automation, document intelligence, AI agents, and custom AI tools

## Case studies

- [Case Studies](https://omniaistudio.in/case-studies): detailed project and client-system documentation

## About

- [About OmniAI Studio](https://omniaistudio.in/about): studio identity, approach, and principles

## Contact

- [Contact](https://omniaistudio.in/contact): official project inquiry page and contact channels

## Accuracy note

Portfolio projects may be prototypes or demonstrations. The site should distinguish verified client outcomes from experiments and should not invent performance claims, clients, testimonials, or results.
